critical_code_review_comments: CategoryMapping.js line 172-173: counts.pending filters by (approved && !applied), matches Card 'Aguardando aplicar' — but the sync-new flow ALWAYS auto-applies (apply=true), so 'Aguardando aplicar' will only fire for edge cases where Bling apply fails after approval. Consider adding a tooltip or the fallback 'Aprovar manualmente' button remains reachable when suggestion_id exists but approved=false — currently that path is dead unless the auto-apply path is skipped.

The Sync-new button badge (line 207-211) hides while syncingNew is true. That is fine, but ensure post-sync `loadPendingCount` runs after `setSyncingNew(false)` — currently the badge count relies on next 4s poll tick, which may briefly show stale data.
server.py sync-new endpoint has no min_length validation on bling_user/bling_pass — dummy empty strings are accepted and only fail asynchronously (pre-existing concern raised in iteration_5).
server.py now 709 lines — still hovering the 700 threshold flagged previously; recommend splitting category-mapping routes.
